facts.fact: The Prime Minister's foreword to the National Data Governance Strategy 2024-2030 (SNGD 2030) speaks of the official launch of the strategy by the government, after a participatory process begun in April 2024 with over 200 experts; the document gives no launch date, so the year is its published date, 2024.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale de la Gouvernance des Données 2024-2030 (SNGD 2030)

note: No fact on use: the strategy plans a national data and AI governance organ and legal texts for 2025, but names no body set up and no rule issued under it.
